import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] gridA = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[12][12];
    static int N, T;
    static boolean[][][][][] memo = new boolean[70][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][][][] canReach = new boolean[12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] arrivalTime = new int[12][12];
    static List<List<Integer>> adjList = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[][] edgeCap = new int[210][210];
    static int[][] edgeFlow = new int[210][210];
    static int[] nodeSupply = new int[210];
    static int[] nodeLevel = new int[210];
    static int[][] nodeID = new int[11][11];

    static void explore(int step, int r, int c, int origR, int origC) {
        if (T >= 70) return;
        if (r < 0 || r >= N || c < 0 || c >= N) return;
        if (gridA[r][c] < '0' || gridA[r][c] > '9') return;
        if (step > T + 1) return;
        if (memo[step][r][c][origR][origC]) return;
        if (step > arrivalTime[r][c] && arrivalTime[r][c] != 0) return;
        if (step == arrivalTime[r][c] && arrivalTime[r][c] != 0 && (gridB[r][c] > '9' || gridB[r][c] <= '0')) return;
        memo[step][r][c][origR][origC] = true;
        if (step < arrivalTime[r][c]) {
            explore(step + 1, r, c, origR, origC);
            explore(step + 1, r + 1, c, origR, origC);
            explore(step + 1, r - 1, c, origR, origC);
            explore(step + 1, r, c + 1, origR, origC);
            explore(step + 1, r, c - 1, origR, origC);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = scanner.nextInt();
        T = scanner.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                gridA[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                gridB[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        Deque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; ++j) {
                arrivalTime[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    arrivalTime[i][j] = 0;
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        final int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        final int[] dc = {0, -1, 0, 1};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            if (arrivalTime[r][c] >= T) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nr = r + dr[d], nc = c + dc[d];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < N && nc >= 0 && nc < N &&
                    gridA[nr][nc] >= '0' && gridA[nr][nc] <= '9' && arrivalTime[nr][nc] == -1) {
                    arrivalTime[nr][nc] = arrivalTime[r][c] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (arrivalTime[i][j] == -1) arrivalTime[i][j] = T;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (gridA[i][j] >= '0' && gridA[i][j] <= '9') {
                    explore(0, i, j, i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < N; ++i1) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < N; ++j1) {
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < N; ++i2) {
                    for (int j2 = 0; j2 < N; ++j2) {
                        for (int s = 0; s <= T; ++s) {
                            if (memo[s][i1][j1][i2][j2]) {
                                canReach[i1][j1][i2][j2] = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        adjList.add(new ArrayList<>());
        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < N; ++i1) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < N; ++j1) {
                if (gridA[i1][j1] > '0' && gridA[i1][j1] <= '9') {
                    int u = adjList.size();
                    adjList.add(new ArrayList<>());
                    nodeSupply[u] = gridA[i1][j1] - '0';
                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < N; ++i2) {
                        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < N; ++j2) {
                            if (gridB[i2][j2] > '0' && gridB[i2][j2] <= '9' && canReach[i2][j2][i1][j1]) {
                                int v;
                                if (nodeID[i2][j2] == 0) {
                                    nodeID[i2][j2] = adjList.size();
                                    adjList.add(new ArrayList<>());
                                }
                                v = nodeID[i2][j2];
                                adjList.get(u).add(v);
                                adjList.get(v).add(u);
                                edgeCap[u][v] = 10000;
                                edgeCap[v][u] = 0;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i2 = 0; i2 < N; ++i2) {
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 < N; ++j2) {
                if (gridB[i2][j2] > '0' && gridB[i2][j2] <= '9' && nodeID[i2][j2] > 0) {
                    int v = nodeID[i2][j2];
                    adjList.get(v).add(0);
                    edgeCap[v][0] = gridB[i2][j2] - '0';
                    edgeCap[0][v] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < adjList.size(); ++i) {
            nodeLevel[i] = 0;
        }
        nodeLevel[0] = adjList.size();

        while (true) {
            boolean anyChange = false;
            for (int u = 1; u < adjList.size(); ++u) {
                while (nodeSupply[u] > 0) {
                    boolean pushed = false;
                    int minLvl = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (int v : adjList.get(u)) {
                        if (edgeCap[u][v] - edgeFlow[u][v] > 0) {
                            minLvl = Math.min(minLvl, nodeLevel[v]);
                        }
                        if (edgeCap[u][v] - edgeFlow[u][v] > 0 && nodeLevel[u] == nodeLevel[v] + 1) {
                            int delta = Math.min(edgeCap[u][v] - edgeFlow[u][v], nodeSupply[u]);
                            edgeFlow[u][v] += delta;
                            edgeFlow[v][u] -= delta;
                            nodeSupply[u] -= delta;
                            nodeSupply[v] += delta;
                            pushed = true;
                            anyChange = true;
                            if (nodeSupply[u] == 0) {
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (nodeLevel[u] != minLvl + 1 && minLvl != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                        nodeLevel[u] = minLvl + 1;
                        anyChange = true;
                    }
                    if (!pushed) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!anyChange) {
                break;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(nodeSupply[0]);
    }
}
